visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short dark hair wearing a white button-down shirt stands in a brightly lit pharmacy-like setting with shelves of medication in the background. He looks distressed, touching his temples while colorful cartoon icons of lightning and scribbles appear around his head. (2) The scene cuts to a female pharmacist in a white lab coat and glasses standing in front of a purple and white branded background. She holds up a box of Benzac AC Gel and points toward information on the screen, while animated yellow and blue mascot characters representing 'AC' and 'BPO' ingredients appear beside her. (3) The young male returns, now holding a tube of the gel and applying it to a red spot on his cheek; large purple and white text bubbles and circular icons emphasize the action as he smiles confidently at the camera. (4) The pharmacist reappears, gesturing towards three distinct Benzac product bottles arranged in a row labeled as steps one through three, set against the pharmacy shelf background. (5) The male stands holding the product tube while a 'Before' and 'After' circular graphic overlays his face, showing a transition from a red spot to clear skin. (6) He is then seen in a stylized purple setting with a traditional Chinese deity character, holding a purple collaboration box and traditional incense sticks as promotional graphics for electronics appear around him. (7) A final static shot displays three Benzac products—a face wash, a gel tube, and a foaming cleanser—against a clean white and purple background with brand logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, major-mode electronic pop track characterized by a bright synth lead and a steady percussive beat. A male voice speaks with high arousal and rapid speech rate, sounding distressed and questioning. A subtle 'whoosh' SFX marks the transition. (2) A female voice enters with a professional, clear, and friendly tone, speaking at a moderate pace. The background music continues at a consistent volume. Digital 'pop' sound effects trigger as graphic elements appear on screen. (3) The male voice returns, sounding energetic and assertive. A sharp 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a statistic being mentioned. (4) The female voice provides instructional details, maintaining high articulation clarity. The BGM remains a constant upbeat backdrop with synth textures. (5) A loud, energetic 'Yeah!' vocalization from the male occurs, coinciding with a rhythmic peak in the music. (6) The male voice narrates a promotional collaboration with a slightly lower, more narrative tone, while cartoon-style 'boing' or 'twinkle' SFX punctuate the mention of prizes. (7) The music reaches a short crescendo before a hard cut at the very end of the clip, leaving a second of studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Professional Solution -> Product Benefits -> Call to Action/Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for Benzac AC Gel, aimed at young people dealing with stress-induced acne. It uses a relatable scenario of late-night stress causing breakouts, followed by an authoritative pharmacist's recommendation to establish trust. The video highlights the unique 'AC' and 'BPO' ingredients and concludes with a high-incentive promotional giveaway tied to a well-known local temple collaboration to drive sales and engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, pharmacist's professional endorsement, brand slogans, and a dedicated giveaway for the product set.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video employs a typical social-media 'variety show' editing style with high text density and frequent SFX to maintain viewer attention. The collaboration with Guandu Temple adds a unique local cultural element to the beauty product promotion.
